def print_err(s):
    sys.stderr.write(s + "\n")

def err_exit(msg, code=1):
    print_err(msg)
    sys.exit(code)

def warn_lstat(p):
    print_err(f"zk: warning: lstat {p}: no such file or directory")

def first_missing(p):
    p = os.path.abspath(p)
    parts = pathlib.Path(p).parts
    cur = parts[0]
    built = cur
    for comp in parts[1:]:
        built = os.path.join(built, comp)
        try:
            os.lstat(built)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return built
    return None

def existing_parent(p):
    p = os.path.abspath(p)
    cur = pathlib.Path(p)
    while True:
        if os.path.exists(cur):
            return str(cur)
        if cur.parent == cur:
            return None
        cur = cur.parent

def is_nb(path):
    return os.path.isdir(os.path.join(path, ".zk"))

def find_nb(start):
    cur = pathlib.Path(os.path.abspath(start))
    if cur.is_file():
        cur = cur.parent
    while True:
        if is_nb(str(cur)):
            return str(cur)
        if cur.parent == cur:
            return None
        cur = cur.parent

def abs_from(p, cwd):
    if os.path.isabs(p):
        return os.path.abspath(p)
    return os.path.abspath(os.path.join(cwd, p))

def resolve_nb(nd, wd, cwd):
    # returns notebook_path, effective_wd
    if nd is not None:
        nd_abs = abs_from(nd, cwd)
        nd_missing = first_missing(nd_abs)
        if nd_missing:
            parent = existing_parent(nd_abs)
            nb = find_nb(parent) if parent else None
            if nb:
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                eff_wd = abs_from(wd, cwd) if wd else cwd
                return nb, eff_wd
            else:
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {nd} or a parent directory")
        else:
            nb = find_nb(nd_abs)
            if nb:
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                eff_wd = abs_from(wd, cwd) if wd else cwd
                return nb, eff_wd
            else:
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {nd} or a parent directory")
    else:
        if wd:
            wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
            wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
            if wd_missing:
                parent = existing_parent(wd_abs)
                nb = find_nb(parent) if parent else None
                if nb:
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    return nb, wd_abs
                else:
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {wd} or a parent directory")
            else:
                nb = find_nb(wd_abs)
                if nb:
                    return nb, wd_abs
                else:
                    err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {wd} or a parent directory")
        else:
            nb = find_nb(cwd)
            if nb:
                return nb, cwd
            else:
                err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {cwd} or a parent directory")

def load_config(nb_path):
    cfg_path = os.path.join(nb_path, ".zk", "config.toml")
    if not os.path.exists(cfg_path):
        return {}
    try:
        with open(cfg_path, "rb") as f:
            return tomli.load(f)
    except tomli.TOMLDecodeError as ex:
        m = re.search(r'line (\d+) col (\d+)', str(ex))
        if m:
            line = m.group(1)
            col = m.group(2)
            msg = "duplicated tables" if "duplicate" in str(ex).lower() else str(ex).split(" at line")[0]
            err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: failed to read config: ({line}, {col}): {msg}")
        else:
            err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: failed to read config: {ex}")

def get_note_cfg(config, group_name=None, dir_path=None):
    note_cfg = {
        "default-title": "Untitled",
        "filename": "{{id}}",
        "extension": "md",
        "template": "default.md",
        "id-charset": "alphanum",
        "id-length": 4,
        "id-case": "lower",
    }
    extra = {}
    if "note" in config:
        for k,v in config["note"].items():
            note_cfg[k]=v
    if "extra" in config:
        extra = config["extra"].copy()
    md_cfg = {
        "link-format": "wiki",
        "link-encode-path": None,
        "link-drop-extension": None,
        "hashtags": True,
        "colon-tags": False,
        "multiword-tags": False,
    }
    if "format" in config and "markdown" in config["format"]:
        for k,v in config["format"]["markdown"].items():
            md_cfg[k]=v
            md_cfg[k.replace("-", "_")]=v
    effective_group = None
    if group_name:
        effective_group = group_name
    elif dir_path:
        groups = config.get("group", {})
        for gname, gdata in groups.items():
            paths = []
            if isinstance(gdata, dict) and "paths" in gdata:
                paths = gdata["paths"]
            else:
                paths = [gname]
            for p in paths:
                if dir_path == p or dir_path.startswith(p.rstrip("/")+ "/") or fnmatch.fnmatch(dir_path, p):
                    effective_group = gname
                    break
            if effective_group:
                break
    if effective_group:
        groups = config.get("group", {})
        if effective_group not in groups:
            err_exit(f"zk: error: new note: no group named `{effective_group}` found in the config")
        gdata = groups[effective_group]
        if isinstance(gdata, dict):
            if "note" in gdata:
                for k,v in gdata["note"].items():
                    note_cfg[k]=v
            if "extra" in gdata:
                for k,v in gdata["extra"].items():
                    extra[k]=v
    return note_cfg, extra, md_cfg, effective_group

def slugify(s):
    s = s.strip()
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s)
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if unicodedata.category(c)!='Mn')
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', s)
    s = s.strip('-')
    s = re.sub(r'-+', '-', s)
    return s

class TemplateError(Exception):
    pass

def parse_args_templ(s):
    args=[]
    cur=""
    in_q=None
    i=0
    while i < len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if in_q:
            cur+=c
            if c==in_q:
                in_q=None
        else:
            if c in ('"', "'"):
                in_q=c
                cur+=c
            elif c.isspace():
                if cur:
                    args.append(cur)
                    cur=""
            else:
                cur+=c
        i+=1
    if cur:
        args.append(cur)
    return args

def eval_arg(arg, ctx):
    arg=arg.strip()
    if not arg:
        return ""
    if (arg.startswith('"') and arg.endswith('"')) or (arg.startswith("'") and arg.endswith("'")):
        return arg[1:-1]
    if re.match(r'^-?\d+$', arg):
        return int(arg)
    parts=arg.split(".")
    cur=ctx
    for part in parts:
        if part=="this":
            cur=ctx.get("this","")
        elif part=="@key":
            cur=ctx.get("@key","")
        else:
            if isinstance(cur, dict):
                if part in cur:
                    cur=cur[part]
                else:
                    # case-insensitive
                    found=False
                    for k in cur:
                        if k.lower()==part.lower():
                            cur=cur[k]
                            found=True
                            break
                    if not found:
                        return ""
            else:
                return ""
    return cur

def render_template(tmpl_str, ctx):
    # block handling for if, unless, each, with
    def process_blocks(s, c):
        # if
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#if\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/if\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            truthy=bool(val) and str(val)!="" and str(val).lower()!="false" and str(val)!="0"
            rendered=process_blocks(inner, c) if truthy else ""
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#unless\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/unless\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            truthy=bool(val) and str(val)!="" and str(val).lower()!="false" and str(val)!="0"
            rendered="" if truthy else process_blocks(inner, c)
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#each\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/each\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            rendered=""
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                for k,v in val.items():
                    nc=c.copy()
                    nc["@key"]=k
                    nc["this"]=v
                    rendered+=process_blocks(inner, nc)
            elif isinstance(val, (list, tuple)):
                for item in val:
                    nc=c.copy()
                    nc["this"]=item
                    rendered+=process_blocks(inner, nc)
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#with\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/with\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                nc=c.copy()
                nc.update(val)
                rendered=process_blocks(inner, nc)
            else:
                rendered=process_blocks(inner, c)
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        return s

    tmpl = process_blocks(tmpl_str, ctx)

    pattern = re.compile(r'{{\s*([^{}]+?)\s*}}')

    def repl(m):
        inner=m.group(1).strip()
        if inner.startswith("#") or inner.startswith("/"):
            return m.group(0)
        args=parse_args_templ(inner)
        if not args:
            return ""
        helper=args[0]
        rest=args[1:]

        if helper=="date":
            print_err = sys.stderr
            print_err.write("zk: the {{date}} template helper was renamed to {{format-date}}, please update your configuration\n")

        # arity checks
        arity = {
            "slug": 1,
            "prepend": 2,
            "json": 1,
            "format-date": 2,
            "format-link": (1,2),
            "style": 2,
            "list": 1,
            "join": 2,
        }
        if helper in arity:
            exp = arity[helper]
            if isinstance(exp, tuple):
                min_a, max_a = exp
                if not (min_a <= len(rest) <= max_a):
                    # produce error similar to original
                    off=rest[-1] if rest else ""
                    if off.startswith('"') or off.startswith("'"):
                        node=f"String{{Value:'{off[1:-1]}', Pos:{m.start()}}}"
                    else:
                        node=f"String{{Value:'{off}', Pos:{m.start()}}}" if off else f"Expr{{Path:Path{{Original:'{helper}', Pos:2}}, Pos:0}}"
                        # special for format-link with 3 args etc?

def get_base_charset(name):
    if name=="letters":
        return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    if name=="numbers":
        return "0123456789"
    if name=="alphanum":
        return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"
    if name=="hex":
        return "0123456789abcdef"
    return name

def gen_id(charset_name, length, case):
    base=get_base_charset(charset_name)
    res=[]
    for _ in range(length):
        ch=random.choice(base)
        if ch.isalpha():
            if case=="lower":
                ch=ch.lower()
            elif case=="upper":
                ch=ch.upper()
            elif case=="mixed":
                ch=random.choice([ch.lower(), ch.upper()])
        res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)

# Frontmatter and title
def parse_frontmatter(content):
    raw=content
    meta={}
    body=content
    if content.startswith("---\n"):
        lines=content.splitlines()
        end=None
        for i in range(1, len(lines)):
            if lines[i].strip()=="---":
                end=i
                break
        if end is not None:
            fm_text="\n".join(lines[1:end])
            try:
                import yaml
                data=yaml.safe_load(fm_text)
                if isinstance(data, dict):
                    meta=data
            except:
                meta_tmp={}
                cur_key=None
                cur_list=[]
                in_list=False
                for line in lines[1:end]:
                    stripped=line.strip()
                    if not stripped:
                        continue
                    if in_list:
                        if stripped.startswith("- "):
                            cur_list.append(stripped[2:].strip().strip('"').strip("'"))
                            continue
                        else:
                            if cur_key:
                                meta_tmp[cur_key]=cur_list
                            in_list=False
                            cur_list=[]
                            cur_key=None
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        k=k.strip()
                        v=v.strip()
                        if v=="":
                            cur_key=k
                            in_list=True
                            cur_list=[]
                        else:
                            if v.startswith("[") and v.endswith("]"):
                                inner=v[1:-1]
                                items=[x.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for x in inner.split(",") if x.strip()]
                                meta_tmp[k]=items
                            else:
                                if (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')) or (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")):
                                    v=v[1:-1]
                                if v.lower()=="null" or v=="":
                                    meta_tmp[k]=None
                                else:
                                    meta_tmp[k]=v
                if in_list and cur_key:
                    meta_tmp[cur_key]=cur_list
                meta=meta_tmp
            rest="\n".join(lines[end+1:])
            body=rest.lstrip("\n")
            return meta, body, raw
    return {}, body, raw

def extract_title_heading_buggy(heading_text):
    # Implements buggy tag removal keeping last char at end
    allowed = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_/.:@+=$%&'~")
    def is_allowed(c):
        if c.isalnum() or c in "-_/:@+=$%&'~":
            return True
        # unicode letters
        if c.isalpha():
            return True
        return False
    def valid_tag(tag):
        if not tag:
            return False
        if tag.isdigit():
            return False
        return True

    s=heading_text
    out=""
    i=0
    while i < len(s):
        if s[i]=='#' and i+1 < len(s) and s[i+1] not in (' ', '\t', '\n', '\r', ',', '.', '!', '?', ';', '(', ')', '[', ']', '"', '*', '^', '`', '{', '}', '|', '\\', '<', '>', '#'):
            # check preceding char not allowed (to prevent a#foo)
            if i>0 and is_allowed(s[i-1]):
                out+=s[i]
                i+=1
                continue
            j=i+1
            while j < len(s) and is_allowed(s[j]):
                j+=1
            tag=s[i+1:j]
            if not valid_tag(tag):
                out+=s[i]
                i+=1
                continue
            # check if at end (only whitespace after)
            k=j
            while k < len(s) and s[k].isspace():
                k+=1
            at_end = (k>=len(s))
            if at_end:
                out+=tag[-1] if tag else ""
            else:
                out+=""
            i=j
        else:
            out+=s[i]
            i+=1
    return out.strip()

def extract_title(meta, rest_content, raw_content):
    for k in ("title", "Title"):
        if k in meta and meta[k]:
            return str(meta[k])
    content_to_search = rest_content if meta else raw_content
    lines = content_to_search.splitlines()
    for line in lines:
        m=re.match(r'^\s*#{1,6}\s+(.*\S)\s*$', line)
        if m:
            heading=m.group(1)
            cleaned=extract_title_heading_buggy(heading)
            return cleaned
    return ""

def extract_body(meta, rest_content, raw_content, title):
    if meta and ("title" in meta or "Title" in meta):
        return rest_content
    lines_search = (raw_content if not meta else rest_content).splitlines()
    heading_idx=None
    for i,line in enumerate(lines_search):
        if re.match(r'^\s*#{1,6}\s+.*\S', line):
            heading_idx=i
            break
    if heading_idx is not None:
        after="\n".join(lines_search[heading_idx+1:])
        after=after.lstrip("\n")
        return after
    else:
        return rest_content

def extract_lead(body):
    if not body.strip():
        return ""
    parts=re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body)
    for part in parts:
        if part.strip():
            return part.strip()
    return ""

    conn.commit()

    if not quiet:

    # Remove code blocks for hashtag extraction (as per earlier)
    def remove_fenced(s):

    def remove_inline(s):
        return re.sub(r'`[^`]*`', lambda m: " "*len(m.group(0)), s)
    def remove_indented(s):
        lines=s.splitlines()
        out=[]
        for line in lines:
            if line.startswith("    "):

        if not tag:

    tags_ordered=[]

        # Remove multiword patterns
        cleaned = re.sub(r'#[^#\n]+?#', lambda m: " "*len(m.group(0)), cleaned)

                tag=cleaned[i+1:j]

                    if j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j]=='#':

                    i=j
                    continue
            i+=1

    if cfg_colon:

        while i < len(cleaned):
            if cleaned[i]==':':
                if i>0 and is_allowed(cleaned[i-1]):
                    i+=1
                    continue
                # Try to parse colon-separated sequence
                pos=i+1
                collected=[]
                while True:

                    tag=cleaned[start_tag:pos]
                    if not tag:
                        break
                    # For colon, even pure digits valid

                        pos+=1
                        if pos < len(cleaned) and cleaned[pos]==':':

                        if pos < len(cleaned) and not is_allowed(cleaned[pos]) and cleaned[pos]!=':':
                            break
                        continue
                    else:

                if collected:
                    for t in collected:
                        if t not in tags_set:
                            tags_ordered.append(t)
                            tags_set.add(t)
                    i=pos
                    continue
            i+=1

    return tags_ordered

    links=[]

        href=m.group(1)

def print_err(s):
    sys.stderr.write(s + "\n")

def err_exit(msg, code=1):
    print_err(msg)
    sys.exit(code)

def warn_lstat(p):
    print_err(f"zk: warning: lstat {p}: no such file or directory")

def first_missing(p):
    p = os.path.abspath(p)
    parts = pathlib.Path(p).parts
    cur = parts[0]
    built = cur
    for comp in parts[1:]:
        built = os.path.join(built, comp)
        try:
            os.lstat(built)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return built
    return None

def existing_parent(p):
    p = os.path.abspath(p)
    cur = pathlib.Path(p)
    while True:
        if os.path.exists(cur):
            return str(cur)
        if cur.parent == cur:
            return None
        cur = cur.parent

def is_nb(path):
    return os.path.isdir(os.path.join(path, ".zk"))

def find_nb(start):
    cur = pathlib.Path(os.path.abspath(start))
    if cur.is_file():
        cur = cur.parent
    while True:
        if is_nb(str(cur)):
            return str(cur)
        if cur.parent == cur:
            return None
        cur = cur.parent

def abs_from(p, cwd):
    if os.path.isabs(p):
        return os.path.abspath(p)
    return os.path.abspath(os.path.join(cwd, p))

def resolve_nb(nd, wd, cwd):
    # returns notebook_path, effective_wd
    if nd is not None:
        nd_abs = abs_from(nd, cwd)
        nd_missing = first_missing(nd_abs)
        if nd_missing:
            parent = existing_parent(nd_abs)
            nb = find_nb(parent) if parent else None
            if nb:
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                eff_wd = abs_from(wd, cwd) if wd else cwd
                return nb, eff_wd
            else:
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {nd} or a parent directory")
        else:
            nb = find_nb(nd_abs)
            if nb:
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                eff_wd = abs_from(wd, cwd) if wd else cwd
                return nb, eff_wd
            else:
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {nd} or a parent directory")
    else:
        if wd:
            wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
            wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
            if wd_missing:
                parent = existing_parent(wd_abs)
                nb = find_nb(parent) if parent else None
                if nb:
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    return nb, wd_abs
                else:
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {wd} or a parent directory")
            else:
                nb = find_nb(wd_abs)
                if nb:
                    return nb, wd_abs
                else:
                    err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {wd} or a parent directory")
        else:
            nb = find_nb(cwd)
            if nb:
                return nb, cwd
            else:
                err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {cwd} or a parent directory")

def load_config(nb_path):
    cfg_path = os.path.join(nb_path, ".zk", "config.toml")
    if not os.path.exists(cfg_path):
        return {}
    try:
        with open(cfg_path, "rb") as f:
            return tomli.load(f)
    except tomli.TOMLDecodeError as ex:
        m = re.search(r'line (\d+) col (\d+)', str(ex))
        if m:
            line = m.group(1)
            col = m.group(2)
            msg = "duplicated tables" if "duplicate" in str(ex).lower() else str(ex).split(" at line")[0]
            err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: failed to read config: ({line}, {col}): {msg}")
        else:
            err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: failed to read config: {ex}")

def get_note_cfg(config, group_name=None, dir_path=None):
    note_cfg = {
        "default-title": "Untitled",
        "filename": "{{id}}",
        "extension": "md",
        "template": "default.md",
        "id-charset": "alphanum",
        "id-length": 4,
        "id-case": "lower",
    }
    extra = {}
    if "note" in config:
        for k,v in config["note"].items():
            note_cfg[k]=v
    if "extra" in config:
        extra = config["extra"].copy()
    md_cfg = {
        "link-format": "wiki",
        "link-encode-path": None,
        "link-drop-extension": None,
        "hashtags": True,
        "colon-tags": False,
        "multiword-tags": False,
    }
    if "format" in config and "markdown" in config["format"]:
        for k,v in config["format"]["markdown"].items():
            md_cfg[k]=v
            md_cfg[k.replace("-", "_")]=v
    effective_group = None
    if group_name:
        effective_group = group_name
    elif dir_path:
        groups = config.get("group", {})
        for gname, gdata in groups.items():
            paths = []
            if isinstance(gdata, dict) and "paths" in gdata:
                paths = gdata["paths"]
            else:
                paths = [gname]
            for p in paths:
                if dir_path == p or dir_path.startswith(p.rstrip("/")+ "/") or fnmatch.fnmatch(dir_path, p):
                    effective_group = gname
                    break
            if effective_group:
                break
    if effective_group:
        groups = config.get("group", {})
        if effective_group not in groups:
            err_exit(f"zk: error: new note: no group named `{effective_group}` found in the config")
        gdata = groups[effective_group]
        if isinstance(gdata, dict):
            if "note" in gdata:
                for k,v in gdata["note"].items():
                    note_cfg[k]=v
            if "extra" in gdata:
                for k,v in gdata["extra"].items():
                    extra[k]=v
    return note_cfg, extra, md_cfg, effective_group

def slugify(s):
    s = s.strip()
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s)
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if unicodedata.category(c)!='Mn')
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', s)
    s = s.strip('-')
    s = re.sub(r'-+', '-', s)
    return s

class TemplateError(Exception):
    pass

def parse_args_templ(s):
    args=[]
    cur=""
    in_q=None
    i=0
    while i < len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if in_q:
            cur+=c
            if c==in_q:
                in_q=None
        else:
            if c in ('"', "'"):
                in_q=c
                cur+=c
            elif c.isspace():
                if cur:
                    args.append(cur)
                    cur=""
            else:
                cur+=c
        i+=1
    if cur:
        args.append(cur)
    return args

def eval_arg(arg, ctx):
    arg=arg.strip()
    if not arg:
        return ""
    if (arg.startswith('"') and arg.endswith('"')) or (arg.startswith("'") and arg.endswith("'")):
        return arg[1:-1]
    if re.match(r'^-?\d+$', arg):
        return int(arg)
    parts=arg.split(".")
    cur=ctx
    for part in parts:
        if part=="this":
            cur=ctx.get("this","")
        elif part=="@key":
            cur=ctx.get("@key","")
        else:
            if isinstance(cur, dict):
                if part in cur:
                    cur=cur[part]
                else:
                    # case-insensitive
                    found=False
                    for k in cur:
                        if k.lower()==part.lower():
                            cur=cur[k]
                            found=True
                            break
                    if not found:
                        return ""
            else:
                return ""
    return cur

def render_template(tmpl_str, ctx):
    # block handling for if, unless, each, with
    def process_blocks(s, c):
        # if
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#if\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/if\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            truthy=bool(val) and str(val)!="" and str(val).lower()!="false" and str(val)!="0"
            rendered=process_blocks(inner, c) if truthy else ""
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#unless\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/unless\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            truthy=bool(val) and str(val)!="" and str(val).lower()!="false" and str(val)!="0"
            rendered="" if truthy else process_blocks(inner, c)
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#each\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/each\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            rendered=""
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                for k,v in val.items():
                    nc=c.copy()
                    nc["@key"]=k
                    nc["this"]=v
                    rendered+=process_blocks(inner, nc)
            elif isinstance(val, (list, tuple)):
                for item in val:
                    nc=c.copy()
                    nc["this"]=item
                    rendered+=process_blocks(inner, nc)
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#with\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/with\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                nc=c.copy()
                nc.update(val)
                rendered=process_blocks(inner, nc)
            else:
                rendered=process_blocks(inner, c)
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        return s

    tmpl = process_blocks(tmpl_str, ctx)

    pattern = re.compile(r'{{\s*([^{}]+?)\s*}}')

    def repl(m):
        inner=m.group(1).strip()
        if inner.startswith("#") or inner.startswith("/"):
            return m.group(0)
        args=parse_args_templ(inner)
        if not args:
            return ""
        helper=args[0]
        rest=args[1:]

        if helper=="date":
            print_err = sys.stderr
            print_err.write("zk: the {{date}} template helper was renamed to {{format-date}}, please update your configuration\n")

        # arity checks
        arity = {
            "slug": 1,
            "prepend": 2,
            "json": 1,
            "format-date": 2,
            "format-link": (1,2),
            "style": 2,
            "list": 1,
            "join": 2,
        }
        if helper in arity:
            exp = arity[helper]
            if isinstance(exp, tuple):
                min_a, max_a = exp
                if not (min_a <= len(rest) <= max_a):
                    # produce error similar to original
                    off=rest[-1] if rest else ""
                    if off.startswith('"') or off.startswith("'"):
                        node=f"String{{Value:'{off[1:-1]}', Pos:{m.start()}}}"
                    else:
                        node=f"String{{Value:'{off}', Pos:{m.start()}}}" if off else f"Expr{{Path:Path{{Original:'{helper}', Pos:2}}, Pos:0}}"
                        # special for format-link with 3 args etc?
                        if helper=="format-link" and len(rest)==3:
                            node=f"String{{Value:'{rest[2][1:-1] if rest[2].startswith(chr(34)) else rest[2]}', Pos:{m.start()+15}}}"
                        if helper=="slug" and len(rest)==2:
                            node=f"String{{Value:'{rest[1][1:-1]}', Pos:{m.start()+7}}}"
                        if helper=="prepend" and len(rest)==0:
                            node=f"Expr{{Path:Path{{Original:'{helper}', Pos:2}}, Pos:0}}"
                        if helper=="prepend" and len(rest)==3:
                            node=f"String{{Value:'{rest[2][1:-1]}', Pos:{m.start()+12}}}"
                    raise TemplateError(f"Helper '{helper}' called with wrong number of arguments, needed {exp[0]} but got {len(rest)}", node)
            else:
                if len(rest)!=exp:
                    off=rest[exp] if len(rest)>exp else (rest[-1] if rest else "")
                    if helper=="format-date" and len(rest)==0:
                        node=f"Expr{{Path:Path{{Original:'{helper}', Pos:2}}, Pos:0}}"
                    elif off.startswith('"') or off.startswith("'"):
                        node=f"String{{Value:'{off[1:-1]}', Pos:{m.start()}}}"
                    else:
                        node=f"Expr{{Path:Path{{Original:'{helper}', Pos:2}}, Pos:0}}" if not off else f"Path{{Original:'{off}', Pos:{m.start()}}}"
                        if helper=="slug" and len(rest)==2:
                            node=f"String{{Value:'{rest[1][1:-1]}', Pos:503}}" # original example pos 503 for slug with list? but we approximate
                    raise TemplateError(f"Helper '{helper}' called with wrong number of arguments, needed {exp} but got {len(rest)}", node)

        if helper in ("list", "join"):
            if rest and (rest[0].startswith('"') or rest[0].startswith("'")):
                # type error
                val=rest[0][1:-1]
                raise TemplateError(f"Helper {helper} called with argument 0 with type string but it should be []string", f"String{{Value:'{val}', Pos:{m.start()+5}}}")

        if helper=="format-date":
            if rest and (rest[0].startswith('"') or rest[0].startswith("'")):
                raise TemplateError(f"Helper format-date called with argument 0 with type string but it should be time.Time", f"String{{Value:'{rest[0][1:-1]}', Pos:{m.start()}}}")

        # actual evaluation
        try:
            if helper=="slug":
                v=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx) if rest else ""
                return slugify(str(v))
            elif helper=="prepend":
                a=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx)
                b=eval_arg(rest[1], ctx)
                return str(a)+str(b)
            elif helper=="json":
                v=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx) if rest else ctx
                return json.dumps(v)
            elif helper=="format-date":
                time_val=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx)
                fmt=eval_arg(rest[1], ctx) if len(rest)>=2 else "%Y-%m-%d"
                dt=None
                if isinstance(time_val, datetime.datetime):
                    dt=time_val
                else:
                    dt=ctx.get("Now")
                if not isinstance(dt, datetime.datetime):
                    dt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
                try:
                    return dt.strftime(fmt)
                except:
                    return str(dt)
            elif helper=="format-link":
                path_arg=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx) if len(rest)>=1 else ""
                title_arg=eval_arg(rest[1], ctx) if len(rest)>=2 else ""
                md_cfg=ctx.get("_md_config", {})
                link_format=md_cfg.get("link-format", "wiki")
                drop_ext=md_cfg.get("link-drop-extension")
                encode=md_cfg.get("link-encode-path")
                if drop_ext is None:
                    drop_ext=True
                if encode is None:
                    encode=True if link_format=="markdown" else False
                p=str(path_arg)
                if drop_ext:
                    p_no_ext=os.path.splitext(p)[0]
                else:
                    p_no_ext=p
                if encode:
                    p_enc=urllib.parse.quote(p_no_ext, safe="/-_.~")
                else:
                    p_enc=p_no_ext
                if link_format=="wiki":
                    return f"[[{p_enc}]]"
                elif link_format=="markdown":
                    return f"[{title_arg}]({p_enc})"
                else:
                    tmpl=link_format
                    tmpl=tmpl.replace("{{path}}", p_enc).replace("{{title}}", str(title_arg))
                    return tmpl
            elif helper=="style":
                return str(eval_arg(rest[1], ctx)) if len(rest)>=2 else ""
            elif helper=="env":
                return str(ctx.get("Env", {}))
            elif helper=="now":
                now_dt=ctx.get("Now")
                if not isinstance(now_dt, datetime.datetime):
                    now_dt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
                frac=f"{now_dt.microsecond*1000:09d}"
                return now_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")+f".{frac} +0000 UTC m=+0.000000000"
            elif helper=="date":
                now_dt=ctx.get("Now")
                if not isinstance(now_dt, datetime.datetime):
                    now_dt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
                frac=f"{now_dt.microsecond*1000:09d}"
                return now_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")+f".{frac} +0000 UTC m=+0.000000000"
            elif helper in ("shy-slug","kebab","snake","pascal","lower","upper","trim","trim-prefix","trim-suffix","substr"):
                return ""
            else:
                v=eval_arg(helper, ctx)
                return str(v) if v!="" else ""
        except TemplateError:
            raise
        except Exception:
            return ""

    try:
        return pattern.sub(repl, tmpl)
    except TemplateError as e:
        # Re-raise with node info for outer handler
        raise e

def get_base_charset(name):
    if name=="letters":
        return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    if name=="numbers":
        return "0123456789"
    if name=="alphanum":
        return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"
    if name=="hex":
        return "0123456789abcdef"
    return name

def gen_id(charset_name, length, case):
    base=get_base_charset(charset_name)
    res=[]
    for _ in range(length):
        ch=random.choice(base)
        if ch.isalpha():
            if case=="lower":
                ch=ch.lower()
            elif case=="upper":
                ch=ch.upper()
            elif case=="mixed":
                ch=random.choice([ch.lower(), ch.upper()])
        res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)

# Frontmatter and title
def parse_frontmatter(content):
    raw=content
    meta={}
    body=content
    if content.startswith("---\n"):
        lines=content.splitlines()
        end=None
        for i in range(1, len(lines)):
            if lines[i].strip()=="---":
                end=i
                break
        if end is not None:
            fm_text="\n".join(lines[1:end])
            try:
                import yaml
                data=yaml.safe_load(fm_text)
                if isinstance(data, dict):
                    meta=data
            except:
                meta_tmp={}
                cur_key=None
                cur_list=[]
                in_list=False
                for line in lines[1:end]:
                    stripped=line.strip()
                    if not stripped:
                        continue
                    if in_list:
                        if stripped.startswith("- "):
                            cur_list.append(stripped[2:].strip().strip('"').strip("'"))
                            continue
                        else:
                            if cur_key:
                                meta_tmp[cur_key]=cur_list
                            in_list=False
                            cur_list=[]
                            cur_key=None
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        k=k.strip()
                        v=v.strip()
                        if v=="":
                            cur_key=k
                            in_list=True
                            cur_list=[]
                        else:
                            if v.startswith("[") and v.endswith("]"):
                                inner=v[1:-1]
                                items=[x.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for x in inner.split(",") if x.strip()]
                                meta_tmp[k]=items
                            else:
                                if (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')) or (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")):
                                    v=v[1:-1]
                                if v.lower()=="null" or v=="":
                                    meta_tmp[k]=None
                                else:
                                    meta_tmp[k]=v
                if in_list and cur_key:
                    meta_tmp[cur_key]=cur_list
                meta=meta_tmp
            rest="\n".join(lines[end+1:])
            body=rest.lstrip("\n")
            return meta, body, raw
    return {}, body, raw

def extract_title_heading_buggy(heading_text):
    # Implements buggy tag removal keeping last char at end
    allowed = set("abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyzABCDEFGHIJKLMNOPQRSTUVWXYZ0123456789-_/.:@+=$%&'~")
    def is_allowed(c):
        if c.isalnum() or c in "-_/:@+=$%&'~":
            return True
        # unicode letters
        if c.isalpha():
            return True
        return False
    def valid_tag(tag):
        if not tag:
            return False
        if tag.isdigit():
            return False
        return True

    s=heading_text
    out=""
    i=0
    while i < len(s):
        if s[i]=='#' and i+1 < len(s) and s[i+1] not in (' ', '\t', '\n', '\r', ',', '.', '!', '?', ';', '(', ')', '[', ']', '"', '*', '^', '`', '{', '}', '|', '\\', '<', '>', '#'):
            # check preceding char not allowed (to prevent a#foo)
            if i>0 and is_allowed(s[i-1]):
                out+=s[i]
                i+=1
                continue
            j=i+1
            while j < len(s) and is_allowed(s[j]):
                j+=1
            tag=s[i+1:j]
            if not valid_tag(tag):
                out+=s[i]
                i+=1
                continue
            # check if at end (only whitespace after)
            k=j
            while k < len(s) and s[k].isspace():
                k+=1
            at_end = (k>=len(s))
            if at_end:
                out+=tag[-1] if tag else ""
            else:
                out+=""
            i=j
        else:
            out+=s[i]
            i+=1
    return out.strip()

def extract_title(meta, rest_content, raw_content):
    for k in ("title", "Title"):
        if k in meta and meta[k]:
            return str(meta[k])
    content_to_search = rest_content if meta else raw_content
    lines = content_to_search.splitlines()
    for line in lines:
        m=re.match(r'^\s*#{1,6}\s+(.*\S)\s*$', line)
        if m:
            heading=m.group(1)
            cleaned=extract_title_heading_buggy(heading)
            return cleaned
    return ""

def extract_body(meta, rest_content, raw_content, title):
    if meta and ("title" in meta or "Title" in meta):
        return rest_content
    lines_search = (raw_content if not meta else rest_content).splitlines()
    heading_idx=None
    for i,line in enumerate(lines_search):
        if re.match(r'^\s*#{1,6}\s+.*\S', line):
            heading_idx=i
            break
    if heading_idx is not None:
        after="\n".join(lines_search[heading_idx+1:])
        after=after.lstrip("\n")
        return after
    else:
        return rest_content

def extract_lead(body):
    if not body.strip():
        return ""
    parts=re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body)
    for part in parts:
        if part.strip():
            return part.strip()
    return ""

        return "\n".join(out)

        is_ext=False

        rels=[]

        links.append({"href": href, "title": title, "type":"markdown", "isExternal": False, "rels": rels, "match": m})
    return links
