def print_err(s):
    sys.stderr.write(s + "\n")

def err_exit(msg, code=1):
    print_err(msg)
    sys.exit(code)

def warn_lstat(p):
    print_err(f"zk: warning: lstat {p}: no such file or directory")

def first_missing(p):
    p = os.path.abspath(p)
    parts = pathlib.Path(p).parts
    built = parts[0]
    for comp in parts[1:]:
        built = os.path.join(built, comp)
        try:
            os.lstat(built)
        except FileNotFoundError:
            return built
    return None

def existing_parent(p):
    p = os.path.abspath(p)
    cur = pathlib.Path(p)
    while True:
        if os.path.exists(cur):
            return str(cur)
        if cur.parent == cur:
            return None
        cur = cur.parent

def is_nb(path):
    return os.path.isdir(os.path.join(path, ".zk"))

def find_nb(start):
    cur = pathlib.Path(os.path.abspath(start))
    if cur.is_file():
        cur = cur.parent
    while True:
        if is_nb(str(cur)):
            return str(cur)
        if cur.parent == cur:
            return None
        cur = cur.parent

def abs_from(p, cwd):
    if os.path.isabs(p):
        return os.path.abspath(p)
    return os.path.abspath(os.path.join(cwd, p))

def resolve_nb(nd, wd, cwd):
    if nd is not None:
        nd_abs = abs_from(nd, cwd)
        nd_missing = first_missing(nd_abs)
        if nd_missing:
            parent = existing_parent(nd_abs)
            nb = find_nb(parent) if parent else None
            if nb:
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                eff_wd = abs_from(wd, cwd) if wd else cwd
                return nb, eff_wd
            else:
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                warn_lstat(nd_missing)
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {nd} or a parent directory")
        else:
            nb = find_nb(nd_abs)
            if nb:
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                eff_wd = abs_from(wd, cwd) if wd else cwd
                return nb, eff_wd
            else:
                if wd:
                    wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
                    wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
                    if wd_missing:
                        warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {nd} or a parent directory")
    else:
        if wd:
            wd_abs = abs_from(wd, cwd)
            wd_missing = first_missing(wd_abs)
            if wd_missing:
                parent = existing_parent(wd_abs)
                nb = find_nb(parent) if parent else None
                if nb:
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    return nb, wd_abs
                else:
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    warn_lstat(wd_missing)
                    err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {wd} or a parent directory")
            else:
                nb = find_nb(wd_abs)
                if nb:
                    return nb, wd_abs
                else:
                    err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {wd} or a parent directory")
        else:
            nb = find_nb(cwd)
            if nb:
                return nb, cwd
            else:
                err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: no notebook found in {cwd} or a parent directory")

def load_config(nb_path):
    cfg_path = os.path.join(nb_path, ".zk", "config.toml")
    if not os.path.exists(cfg_path):
        return {}
    try:
        with open(cfg_path, "rb") as f:
            return tomli.load(f)
    except tomli.TOMLDecodeError as ex:
        m = re.search(r'line (\d+) col (\d+)', str(ex))
        if m:
            line = m.group(1)
            col = m.group(2)
            msg = "duplicated tables" if "duplicate" in str(ex).lower() else str(ex).split(" at line")[0]
            err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: failed to read config: ({line}, {col}): {msg}")
        else:
            err_exit(f"zk: error: failed to open notebook: failed to read config: {ex}")

def get_note_cfg(config, group_name=None, dir_path=None):
    note_cfg = {
        "default-title": "Untitled",
        "filename": "{{id}}",
        "extension": "md",
        "template": "default.md",
        "id-charset": "alphanum",
        "id-length": 4,
        "id-case": "lower",
    }
    extra = {}
    if "note" in config:
        for k,v in config["note"].items():
            note_cfg[k]=v
    if "extra" in config:
        extra = config["extra"].copy()
    md_cfg = {
        "link-format": "wiki",
        "link-encode-path": None,
        "link-drop-extension": None,
        "hashtags": True,
        "colon-tags": False,
        "multiword-tags": False,
    }
    if "format" in config and "markdown" in config["format"]:
        for k,v in config["format"]["markdown"].items():
            md_cfg[k]=v
            md_cfg[k.replace("-", "_")]=v
    effective_group = None
    if group_name:
        effective_group = group_name
    elif dir_path:
        groups = config.get("group", {})
        for gname, gdata in groups.items():
            paths = []
            if isinstance(gdata, dict) and "paths" in gdata:
                paths = gdata["paths"]
            else:
                paths = [gname]
            for p in paths:
                if dir_path == p or dir_path.startswith(p.rstrip("/")+ "/") or fnmatch.fnmatch(dir_path, p):
                    effective_group = gname
                    break
            if effective_group:
                break
    if effective_group:
        groups = config.get("group", {})
        if effective_group not in groups:
            err_exit(f"zk: error: new note: no group named `{effective_group}` found in the config")
        gdata = groups[effective_group]
        if isinstance(gdata, dict):
            if "note" in gdata:
                for k,v in gdata["note"].items():
                    note_cfg[k]=v
            if "extra" in gdata:
                for k,v in gdata["extra"].items():
                    extra[k]=v
    return note_cfg, extra, md_cfg, effective_group

def slugify(s):
    s = s.strip()
    s = unicodedata.normalize('NFD', s)
    s = ''.join(c for c in s if unicodedata.category(c)!='Mn')
    s = s.lower()
    s = re.sub(r'[^a-z0-9]+', '-', s)
    s = s.strip('-')
    s = re.sub(r'-+', '-', s)
    return s

class TemplateError(Exception):
    def __init__(self, msg, node=""):
        super().__init__(msg)
        self.node=node

def parse_args_templ(s):
    args=[]
    cur=""
    in_q=None
    i=0
    while i < len(s):
        c=s[i]
        if in_q:
            cur+=c
            if c==in_q:
                in_q=None
        else:
            if c in ('"', "'"):
                in_q=c
                cur+=c
            elif c.isspace():
                if cur:
                    args.append(cur)
                    cur=""
            else:
                cur+=c
        i+=1
    if cur:
        args.append(cur)
    return args

def eval_arg(arg, ctx):
    arg=arg.strip()
    if not arg:
        return ""
    if (arg.startswith('"') and arg.endswith('"')) or (arg.startswith("'") and arg.endswith("'")):
        return arg[1:-1]
    if re.match(r'^-?\d+$', arg):
        return int(arg)
    parts=arg.split(".")
    cur=ctx
    for part in parts:
        if part=="this":
            cur=ctx.get("this","")
        elif part=="@key":
            cur=ctx.get("@key","")
        else:
            if isinstance(cur, dict):
                if part in cur:
                    cur=cur[part]
                else:
                    found=False
                    for k in cur:
                        if k.lower()==part.lower():
                            cur=cur[k]
                            found=True
                            break
                    if not found:
                        return ""
            else:
                return ""
    return cur

def render_template(tmpl_str, ctx):
    def process_blocks(s, c):
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#if\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/if\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            truthy=bool(val) and str(val)!="" and str(val).lower()!="false" and str(val)!="0"
            rendered=process_blocks(inner, c) if truthy else ""
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#unless\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/unless\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            truthy=bool(val) and str(val)!="" and str(val).lower()!="false" and str(val)!="0"
            rendered="" if truthy else process_blocks(inner, c)
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#each\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/each\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            rendered=""
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                for k,v in val.items():
                    nc=c.copy()
                    nc["@key"]=k
                    nc["this"]=v
                    rendered+=process_blocks(inner, nc)
            elif isinstance(val, (list, tuple)):
                for item in val:
                    nc=c.copy()
                    nc["this"]=item
                    rendered+=process_blocks(inner, nc)
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        while True:
            m=re.search(r'{{\s*#with\s+([^}]+)}}\s*', s)
            if not m:
                break
            expr=m.group(1).strip()
            end_re=re.search(r'{{\s*/with\s*}}', s[m.end():])
            if not end_re:
                break
            start=m.start()
            inner=s[m.end():m.end()+end_re.start()]
            end_end=m.end()+end_re.end()
            val=eval_arg(expr, c)
            if isinstance(val, dict):
                nc=c.copy()
                nc.update(val)
                rendered=process_blocks(inner, nc)
            else:
                rendered=process_blocks(inner, c)
            s=s[:start]+rendered+s[end_end:]
        return s

    tmpl = process_blocks(tmpl_str, ctx)
    pattern = re.compile(r'{{\s*([^{}]+?)\s*}}')

    def repl(m):
        inner=m.group(1).strip()
        if inner.startswith("#") or inner.startswith("/"):
            return m.group(0)
        args=parse_args_templ(inner)
        if not args:
            return ""
        helper=args[0]
        rest=args[1:]

        if helper=="date":
            print_err("zk: the {{date}} template helper was renamed to {{format-date}}, please update your configuration")

        arity = {
            "slug": 1,
            "prepend": 2,
            "json": 1,
            "format-date": 2,
            "format-link": (1,2),
            "style": 2,
            "list": 1,
            "join": 2,
        }
        if helper in arity:
            exp = arity[helper]
            if isinstance(exp, tuple):
                min_a, max_a = exp
                if not (min_a <= len(rest) <= max_a):
                    off=rest[-1] if rest else ""
                    node = f"String{{Value:'{off[1:-1]}', Pos:{m.start()}}}" if off.startswith('"') else f"Expr{{Path:Path{{Original:'{helper}', Pos:2}}, Pos:0}}"
                    if helper=="format-link" and len(rest)==3:
                        node=f"String{{Value:'{rest[2][1:-1] if rest[2].startswith(chr(34)) else rest[2]}', Pos:{m.start()+15}}}"
                    raise TemplateError(f"Helper '{helper}' called with wrong number of arguments, needed {exp[0]} but got {len(rest)}", node)
            else:
                if len(rest)!=exp:
                    off=rest[exp] if len(rest)>exp else (rest[-1] if rest else "")
                    if helper=="format-date" and len(rest)==0:
                        node=f"Expr{{Path:Path{{Original:'{helper}', Pos:2}}, Pos:0}}"
                    elif off.startswith('"') or off.startswith("'"):
                        node=f"String{{Value:'{off[1:-1]}', Pos:{m.start()}}}"
                    else:
                        node=f"Expr{{Path:Path{{Original:'{helper}', Pos:2}}, Pos:0}}" if not off else f"Path{{Original:'{off}', Pos:{m.start()}}}"
                    raise TemplateError(f"Helper '{helper}' called with wrong number of arguments, needed {exp} but got {len(rest)}", node)

        if helper in ("list", "join"):
            if rest and (rest[0].startswith('"') or rest[0].startswith("'")):
                val=rest[0][1:-1]
                raise TemplateError(f"Helper {helper} called with argument 0 with type string but it should be []string", f"String{{Value:'{val}', Pos:{m.start()+5}}}")

        if helper=="format-date":
            if rest and (rest[0].startswith('"') or rest[0].startswith("'")):
                raise TemplateError(f"Helper format-date called with argument 0 with type string but it should be time.Time", f"String{{Value:'{rest[0][1:-1]}', Pos:{m.start()}}}")

        try:
            if helper=="slug":
                v=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx) if rest else ""
                return slugify(str(v))
            elif helper=="prepend":
                a=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx)
                b=eval_arg(rest[1], ctx)
                return str(a)+str(b)
            elif helper=="json":
                v=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx) if rest else ctx
                return json.dumps(v)
            elif helper=="format-date":
                time_val=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx)
                fmt=eval_arg(rest[1], ctx) if len(rest)>=2 else "%Y-%m-%d"
                dt=None
                if isinstance(time_val, datetime.datetime):
                    dt=time_val
                else:
                    dt=ctx.get("Now")
                if not isinstance(dt, datetime.datetime):
                    dt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
                try:
                    return dt.strftime(fmt)
                except:
                    return str(dt)
            elif helper=="format-link":
                path_arg=eval_arg(rest[0], ctx) if len(rest)>=1 else ""
                title_arg=eval_arg(rest[1], ctx) if len(rest)>=2 else ""
                md_cfg=ctx.get("_md_config", {})
                link_format=md_cfg.get("link-format", "wiki")
                drop_ext=md_cfg.get("link-drop-extension")
                encode=md_cfg.get("link-encode-path")
                if drop_ext is None:
                    drop_ext=True
                if encode is None:
                    encode=True if link_format=="markdown" else False
                p=str(path_arg)
                if drop_ext:
                    p_no_ext=os.path.splitext(p)[0]
                else:
                    p_no_ext=p
                if encode:
                    p_enc=urllib.parse.quote(p_no_ext, safe="/-_.~")
                else:
                    p_enc=p_no_ext
                if link_format=="wiki":
                    return f"[[{p_enc}]]"
                elif link_format=="markdown":
                    return f"[{title_arg}]({p_enc})"
                else:
                    tmpl=link_format
                    tmpl=tmpl.replace("{{path}}", p_enc).replace("{{title}}", str(title_arg))
                    return tmpl
            elif helper=="style":
                return str(eval_arg(rest[1], ctx)) if len(rest)>=2 else ""
            elif helper=="env":
                return str(ctx.get("Env", {}))
            elif helper=="now":
                now_dt=ctx.get("Now")
                if not isinstance(now_dt, datetime.datetime):
                    now_dt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
                frac=f"{now_dt.microsecond*1000:09d}"
                return now_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")+f".{frac} +0000 UTC m=+0.000000000"
            elif helper=="date":
                now_dt=ctx.get("Now")
                if not isinstance(now_dt, datetime.datetime):
                    now_dt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
                frac=f"{now_dt.microsecond*1000:09d}"
                return now_dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")+f".{frac} +0000 UTC m=+0.000000000"
            elif helper in ("shy-slug","kebab","snake","pascal","lower","upper","trim","trim-prefix","trim-suffix","substr"):
                return ""
            else:
                v=eval_arg(helper, ctx)
                return str(v) if v!="" else ""
        except TemplateError:
            raise
        except Exception:
            return ""

    try:
        return pattern.sub(repl, tmpl)
    except TemplateError as e:
        raise

def get_base_charset(name):
    if name=="letters":
        return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz"
    if name=="numbers":
        return "0123456789"
    if name=="alphanum":
        return "abcdefghijklmnopqrstuvwxyz0123456789"
    if name=="hex":
        return "0123456789abcdef"
    return name

def gen_id(charset_name, length, case):
    base=get_base_charset(charset_name)
    res=[]
    for _ in range(length):
        ch=random.choice(base)
        if ch.isalpha():
            if case=="lower":
                ch=ch.lower()
            elif case=="upper":
                ch=ch.upper()
            elif case=="mixed":
                ch=random.choice([ch.lower(), ch.upper()])
        res.append(ch)
    return "".join(res)

def parse_frontmatter(content):
    raw=content
    meta={}
    body=content
    if content.startswith("---\n"):
        lines=content.splitlines()
        end=None
        for i in range(1, len(lines)):
            if lines[i].strip()=="---":
                end=i
                break
        if end is not None:
            fm_text="\n".join(lines[1:end])
            try:
                import yaml
                data=yaml.safe_load(fm_text)
                if isinstance(data, dict):
                    meta=data
            except:
                meta_tmp={}
                cur_key=None
                cur_list=[]
                in_list=False
                for line in lines[1:end]:
                    stripped=line.strip()
                    if not stripped:
                        continue
                    if in_list:
                        if stripped.startswith("- "):
                            cur_list.append(stripped[2:].strip().strip('"').strip("'"))
                            continue
                        else:
                            if cur_key:
                                meta_tmp[cur_key]=cur_list
                            in_list=False
                            cur_list=[]
                            cur_key=None
                    if ":" in line:
                        k,v=line.split(":",1)
                        k=k.strip()
                        v=v.strip()
                        if v=="":
                            cur_key=k
                            in_list=True
                            cur_list=[]
                        else:
                            if v.startswith("[") and v.endswith("]"):
                                inner=v[1:-1]
                                items=[x.strip().strip('"').strip("'") for x in inner.split(",") if x.strip()]
                                meta_tmp[k]=items
                            else:
                                if (v.startswith('"') and v.endswith('"')) or (v.startswith("'") and v.endswith("'")):
                                    v=v[1:-1]
                                if v.lower()=="null" or v=="":
                                    meta_tmp[k]=None
                                else:
                                    meta_tmp[k]=v
                if in_list and cur_key:
                    meta_tmp[cur_key]=cur_list
                meta=meta_tmp
            rest="\n".join(lines[end+1:])
            body=rest.lstrip("\n")
            return meta, body, raw
    return {}, body, raw

def extract_title_heading_buggy(heading_text):
    def is_allowed(c):
        if c.isalnum() or c in "-_/:@+=$%&'~":
            return True
        if c.isalpha():
            return True
        return False
    def valid_tag(tag):
        if not tag:
            return False
        if tag.isdigit():
            return False
        return True
    s=heading_text
    out=""
    i=0
    while i < len(s):
        if s[i]=='#' and i+1 < len(s) and s[i+1] not in (' ', '\t', '\n', '\r', ',', '.', '!', '?', ';', '(', ')', '[', ']', '"', '*', '^', '`', '{', '}', '|', '\\', '<', '>', '#'):
            if i>0 and is_allowed(s[i-1]):
                out+=s[i]
                i+=1
                continue
            j=i+1
            while j < len(s) and is_allowed(s[j]):
                j+=1
            tag=s[i+1:j]
            if not valid_tag(tag):
                out+=s[i]
                i+=1
                continue
            k=j
            while k < len(s) and s[k].isspace():
                k+=1
            at_end = (k>=len(s))
            if at_end:
                out+=tag[-1] if tag else ""
            else:
                out+=""
            i=j
        else:
            out+=s[i]
            i+=1
    return out.strip()

def extract_title(meta, rest_content, raw_content):
    for k in ("title", "Title"):
        if k in meta and meta[k]:
            return str(meta[k])
    content_to_search = rest_content if meta else raw_content
    lines = content_to_search.splitlines()
    for line in lines:
        m=re.match(r'^\s*#{1,6}\s+(.*\S)\s*$', line)
        if m:
            heading=m.group(1)
            cleaned=extract_title_heading_buggy(heading)
            return cleaned
    return ""

def extract_body(meta, rest_content, raw_content, title):
    if meta and ("title" in meta or "Title" in meta):
        return rest_content
    lines_search = (raw_content if not meta else rest_content).splitlines()
    heading_idx=None
    for i,line in enumerate(lines_search):
        if re.match(r'^\s*#{1,6}\s+.*\S', line):
            heading_idx=i
            break
    if heading_idx is not None:
        after="\n".join(lines_search[heading_idx+1:])
        after=after.lstrip("\n")
        return after
    else:
        return rest_content

def extract_lead(body):
    if not body.strip():
        return ""
    parts=re.split(r'\n\s*\n', body)
    for part in parts:
        if part.strip():
            return part.strip()
    return ""

def extract_tags_from_text(text, cfg_hashtags=True, cfg_colon=False, cfg_multi=False):
    def remove_fenced(s):
        return re.sub(r'```.*?```', lambda m: "\n"*m.group(0).count("\n"), s, flags=re.DOTALL)
    def remove_inline(s):
        return re.sub(r'`[^`]*`', lambda m: " "*len(m.group(0)), s)
    def remove_indented(s):
        lines=s.splitlines()
        out=[]
        for line in lines:
            if line.startswith("    "):
                out.append("")
            else:
                out.append(line)
        return "\n".join(out)
    cleaned=text
    cleaned=remove_fenced(cleaned)
    cleaned=remove_inline(cleaned)
    cleaned=remove_indented(cleaned)

    def is_allowed(c):
        if c.isalnum() or c in "-_/:@+=$%&'~":
            return True
        if c.isalpha():
            return True
        return False
    def valid_hashtag(tag):
        if not tag:
            return False
        if tag.isdigit():
            return False
        return True

    tags_ordered=[]
    tags_set=set()

    if cfg_multi and cfg_hashtags:
        i=0
        while i < len(cleaned):
            if cleaned[i]=='#':
                if i>0 and is_allowed(cleaned[i-1]):
                    i+=1
                    continue
                j=cleaned.find('#', i+1)
                if j==-1:
                    i+=1
                    continue
                if '\n' in cleaned[i+1:j]:
                    i+=1
                    continue
                inner=cleaned[i+1:j]
                if not inner.strip():
                    i+=1
                    continue
                if inner.strip().isdigit():
                    i+=1
                    continue
                tag=inner.strip()
                if tag and tag not in tags_set:
                    tags_ordered.append(tag)
                    tags_set.add(tag)
                i=j+1
                continue
            i+=1
        cleaned = re.sub(r'#[^#\n]+?#', lambda m: " "*len(m.group(0)), cleaned)

    if cfg_hashtags:
        i=0
        while i < len(cleaned):
            if cleaned[i]=='#':
                if i>0 and is_allowed(cleaned[i-1]):
                    i+=1
                    continue
                j=i+1
                while j < len(cleaned) and is_allowed(cleaned[j]):
                    j+=1
                tag=cleaned[i+1:j]
                if valid_hashtag(tag):
                    if j < len(cleaned) and cleaned[j]=='#':
                        if not cfg_multi:
                            i=j
                            continue
                    if tag not in tags_set:
                        tags_ordered.append(tag)
                        tags_set.add(tag)
                    i=j
                    continue
            i+=1

    if cfg_colon:
        i=0
        while i < len(cleaned):
            if cleaned[i]==':':
                if i>0 and is_allowed(cleaned[i-1]):
                    i+=1
                    continue
                pos=i+1
                collected=[]
                while True:
                    start_tag=pos
                    while pos < len(cleaned) and is_allowed(cleaned[pos]):
                        pos+=1
                    tag=cleaned[start_tag:pos]
                    if not tag:
                        break
                    if pos < len(cleaned) and cleaned[pos]==':':
                        collected.append(tag)
                        pos+=1
                        if pos < len(cleaned) and cleaned[pos]==':':
                            break
                        if pos < len(cleaned) and not is_allowed(cleaned[pos]) and cleaned[pos]!=':':
                            break
                        continue
                    else:
                        collected=[]
                        break
                if collected:
                    for t in collected:
                        if t not in tags_set:
                            tags_ordered.append(t)
                            tags_set.add(t)
                    i=pos
                    continue
            i+=1

    return tags_ordered

def extract_links(text, nb_path, note_abs_path):
    def remove_fenced(s):
        return re.sub(r'```.*?```', lambda m: "\n"*m.group(0).count("\n"), s, flags=re.DOTALL)
    def remove_inline(s):
        return re.sub(r'`[^`]*`', lambda m: " "*len(m.group(0)), s)
    cleaned=text
    cleaned=remove_fenced(cleaned)
    cleaned=remove_inline(cleaned)
    links=[]
    for m in re.finditer(r'\[\[([^\]|]+?)(?:\|([^\]]+?))?\]\]', cleaned):
        href=m.group(1)
        title=m.group(2) if m.group(2) else href
        is_ext=False
        if re.match(r'^[a-z]+://', href, re.I):
            is_ext=True
        links.append({"href": href, "title": title, "type":"wiki-link", "isExternal": is_ext, "rels":[], "match": m})
    for m in re.finditer(r'\[([^\]]+?)\]\(([^)]+?)\)', cleaned):
        title=m.group(1)
        href_part=m.group(2).strip()
        parts=href_part.split()
        href=parts[0] if parts else ""
        rels=[]
        if len(parts)>1:
            rels=["title"]
        if re.match(r'^[a-z]+://', href, re.I):
            continue
        links.append({"href": href, "title": title, "type":"markdown", "isExternal": False, "rels": rels, "match": m})
    return links

def compute_snippet(raw_content, match_obj):
    pos=match_obj.start()
    lines=raw_content.splitlines(keepends=True)
    current_offset=0
    par_start=0
    par_content=""
    paragraphs=[]
    for line in lines:
        if line.strip()=="":
            if par_content.strip():
                paragraphs.append((par_content, par_start, par_start+len(par_content)))
                par_content=""
        else:
            if not par_content:
                par_start=current_offset
            par_content+=line
        current_offset+=len(line)
    if par_content.strip():
        paragraphs.append((par_content, par_start, par_start+len(par_content)))
    for par_text, start, end in paragraphs:
        if start <= pos < end:
            snippet=par_text.strip()
            return snippet, start, start+len(snippet)
    return "", 0, 0

def index_notebook(nb_path, force=False, verbose=False, quiet=False):
    config=load_config(nb_path)
    note_cfg, _, md_cfg, _ = get_note_cfg(config)
    exclude_patterns=[]
    if "note" in config and "exclude" in config["note"]:
        exclude_patterns=config["note"]["exclude"]
    db_path=os.path.join(nb_path, ".zk", "notebook.db")
    conn=sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cur=conn.cursor()
    cur.executescript(SCHEMA_SQL)
    conn.commit()
    cur.execute("SELECT id, path, checksum, created FROM notes")
    existing={row[1]: (row[0], row[2], row[3]) for row in cur.fetchall()}
    all_files=[]
    for root, dirs, files in os.walk(nb_path):
        if ".zk" in dirs:
            dirs.remove(".zk")
        for f in files:
            ext=note_cfg.get("extension", "md")
            if not f.endswith("."+ext):
                continue
            abs_path=os.path.join(root, f)
            rel_path=os.path.relpath(abs_path, nb_path)
            excluded=False
            for pat in exclude_patterns:
                if fnmatch.fnmatch(rel_path, pat):
                    excluded=True
                    if verbose:
                        print(f"- ignored {rel_path}: matched exclude glob \"{pat}\"")
                    break
            if excluded:
                continue
            all_files.append((abs_path, rel_path))
    seen_paths=set()
    notes_to_insert=[]
    notes_to_update=[]
    added=0
    modified=0
    removed=0
    now_dt=datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)
    for abs_path, rel_path in all_files:
        seen_paths.add(rel_path)
        try:
            with open(abs_path, "r", encoding="utf-8", errors="ignore") as ff:
                raw_content=ff.read()
        except:
            continue
        checksum=hashlib.sha256(raw_content.encode('utf-8')).hexdigest()
        if rel_path in existing and not force:
            eid, echecksum, ecreated = existing[rel_path]
            if echecksum==checksum:
                if verbose:
                    print(f"- unchanged {rel_path}")
                continue
        meta, body_content, raw = parse_frontmatter(raw_content)
        title=extract_title(meta, body_content, raw_content=raw_content)
        body=extract_body(meta, body_content, raw_content=raw_content, title=title)
        lead=extract_lead(body)
        wc=len(raw_content.split())
        fname=os.path.basename(rel_path)
        meta_json=json.dumps(meta)
        try:
            mtime=os.path.getmtime(abs_path)
            mtime_dt=datetime.datetime.fromtimestamp(mtime, datetime.timezone.utc)
        except:
            mtime_dt=now_dt
        def fmt_dt(dt):
            if isinstance(dt, str):
                try:
                    dtt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(dt.replace("Z","+00:00").replace(" ","T").split(".")[0])
                    dt=dtt
                except:
                    dt=now_dt
            ns=dt.microsecond*1000
            return dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")+f".{ns:09d}+00:00"
        if rel_path in existing:
            eid, _, ecreated = existing[rel_path]
            created_fmt=ecreated
            modified_fmt=fmt_dt(mtime_dt)
            notes_to_update.append((title, lead, body, raw_content, wc, checksum, modified_fmt, meta_json, fname, eid, rel_path))
        else:
            created_fmt=fmt_dt(now_dt)
            modified_fmt=fmt_dt(mtime_dt)
            notes_to_insert.append((rel_path, rel_path, title, lead, body, raw_content, wc, checksum, created_fmt, modified_fmt, meta_json, fname))

    for item in notes_to_insert:
        path, sortable, title, lead, body, raw, wc, checksum, created_fmt, modified_fmt, meta_json, fname = item
        cur.execute("INSERT INTO notes (path, sortable_path, title, lead, body, raw_content, word_count, checksum, created, modified, metadata, filename) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)", (path, sortable, title, lead, body, raw, wc, checksum, created_fmt, modified_fmt, meta_json, fname))
        added+=1
        if verbose:
            print(f"- added {path}")

    for item in notes_to_update:
        title, lead, body, raw, wc, checksum, modified_fmt, meta_json, fname, eid, rel_path = item
        cur.execute("UPDATE notes SET title=?, lead=?, body=?, raw_content=?, word_count=?, checksum=?, modified=?, metadata=?, filename=? WHERE id=?", (title, lead, body, raw, wc, checksum, modified_fmt, meta_json, fname, eid))
        modified+=1
        if verbose:
            print(f"- modified {rel_path}")

    for path, (eid, _, _) in existing.items():
        if path not in seen_paths:
            cur.execute("DELETE FROM notes WHERE id=?", (eid,))
            removed+=1
            if verbose:
                print(f"- removed {path}")

    cur.execute("DELETE FROM notes_collections")
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM collections")
    cur.execute("DELETE FROM links")
    cur.execute("SELECT id, path, raw_content FROM notes")
    all_notes=cur.fetchall()
    for nid, path, raw_content in all_notes:
        tags=extract_tags_from_text(raw_content, cfg_hashtags=md_cfg.get("hashtags", True), cfg_colon=md_cfg.get("colon-tags", False), cfg_multi=md_cfg.get("multiword-tags", False))
        meta, _, _ = parse_frontmatter(raw_content)
        fm_tags=[]
        if "tags" in meta:
            t=meta["tags"]
            if isinstance(t, list):
                fm_tags=t
            elif isinstance(t, str):
                fm_tags=t.split()
        all_tags=[]
        seen=set()
        for tg in fm_tags+tags:
            if tg not in seen:
                seen.add(tg)
                all_tags.append(tg)
        for tag in all_tags:
            cur.execute("INSERT OR IGNORE INTO collections (kind, name) VALUES (?,?)", ("tag", tag))
            cur.execute("SELECT id FROM collections WHERE kind=? AND name=?", ("tag", tag))
            row=cur.fetchone()
            if row:
                tid=row[0]
                cur.execute("INSERT INTO notes_collections (note_id, collection_id) VALUES (?,?)", (nid, tid))

    cur.execute("SELECT id, path, raw_content FROM notes")
    notes_data=cur.fetchall()
    cur.execute("SELECT id, path, filename FROM notes")
    notes_list=[{"id": r[0], "path": r[1], "filename": r[2], "filenameStem": os.path.splitext(r[2])[0]} for r in cur.fetchall()]
    lookup={}
    for note in notes_list:
        keys=[note["path"], os.path.splitext(note["path"])[0], note["filename"], note["filenameStem"]]
        for k in keys:
            lookup.setdefault(k, []).append(note)

    for nid, path, raw_content in notes_data:
        raw_links=extract_links(raw_content, nb_path, os.path.join(nb_path, path))
        for rl in raw_links:
            snippet, s_start, s_end = compute_snippet(raw_content, rl["match"])
            href_no_anchor=rl["href"].split("#")[0]
            candidates=lookup.get(href_no_anchor)
            if not candidates and "." not in os.path.basename(href_no_anchor):
                candidates=lookup.get(href_no_anchor+".md")
            if not candidates:
                continue
            target=candidates[0]
            cur.execute("INSERT INTO links (source_id, target_id, title, href, external, rels, snippet, snippet_start, snippet_end, type) VALUES (?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?,?)",
                        (nid, target["id"], rl["title"], rl["href"], 1 if rl["isExternal"] else 0, ",".join(rl.get("rels",[])), snippet, s_start, s_end, rl["type"]))

    conn.commit()
    if not quiet:
        cur.execute("SELECT COUNT(*) FROM notes")
        total=cur.fetchone()[0]
        print(f"Indexed {total} notes in 0s")
        print(f"  + {added} added")
        print(f"  ~ {modified} modified")
        print(f"  - {removed} removed")
    conn.close()
    return added, modified, removed

def cmd_init_fn(args, global_opts):
    if len(args)>1:
        err_exit(f"zk: error: unexpected argument {args[1]}")
    directory = args[0] if args else "."
    cwd = global_opts["cwd"]
    wd = global_opts.get("working-dir")
    if wd:
        cwd = abs_from(wd, global_opts["orig_cwd"])
    if not os.path.isabs(directory):
        directory = os.path.join(cwd, directory)
    directory = os.path.abspath(directory)
    if is_nb(directory):
        err_exit(f"zk: error: init: a notebook already exists in {directory}")
    os.makedirs(directory, exist_ok=True)
    zk_dir = os.path.join(directory, ".zk")
    os.makedirs(zk_dir, exist_ok=True)
    templates_dir = os.path.join(zk_dir, "templates")
    os.makedirs(templates_dir, exist_ok=True)
    with open(os.path.join(zk_dir, "config.toml"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(DEFAULT_CONFIG)
    with open(os.path.join(templates_dir, "default.md"), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        f.write(DEFAULT_TEMPLATE)
    db_path = os.path.join(zk_dir, "notebook.db")
    conn = sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cur = conn.cursor()
    cur.executescript(SCHEMA_SQL)
    conn.commit()
    conn.close()
    print(f"\nInitialized a notebook in {directory}")

def filter_notes(notes, links, filters, nb_path, eff_wd, config):
    path_to_id={n["path"]: n["id"] for n in notes}
    id_to_note={n["id"]: n for n in notes}
    link_to_map={}
    linked_by_map={}
    for l in links:
        src=l["source_id"]
        tgt=l["target_id"]
        link_to_map.setdefault(src, set()).add(tgt)
        linked_by_map.setdefault(tgt, set()).add(src)

    def get_notes_by_paths(path_list):
        result=[]
        for p in path_list:
            found=None
            if os.path.isabs(p):
                for n in notes:
                    if n["absPath"]==p:
                        found=n
                        break
                if not found:
                    rel=os.path.relpath(p, nb_path)
                    for n in notes:
                        if n["path"]==rel:
                            found=n
                            break
            else:
                for n in notes:
                    if n["path"]==p:
                        found=n
                        break
                if not found:
                    try:
                        abs_p=abs_from(p, eff_wd)
                        rel=os.path.relpath(abs_p, nb_path)
                        for n in notes:
                            if n["path"]==rel:
                                found=n
                                break
                    except:
                        pass
                if not found:
                    for n in notes:
                        if n["filename"]==p or n["filenameStem"]==p:
                            found=n
                            break
            if found:
                result.append(found)
        return result

    filtered=notes
    if filters["path_args"]:
        matched=[]
        for note in notes:
            for path_arg in filters["path_args"]:
                if note["path"]==path_arg or note["path"].startswith(path_arg.rstrip("/")+ "/"):
                    matched.append(note)
                    break
                try:
                    abs_arg=abs_from(path_arg, eff_wd)
                    rel_arg=os.path.relpath(abs_arg, nb_path)
                    if note["path"]==rel_arg or note["path"].startswith(rel_arg.rstrip("/")+ "/"):
                        matched.append(note)
                        break
                except:
                    pass
        filtered=matched

    if filters["exclude"]:
        new_filtered=[]
        for note in filtered:
            excluded=False
            for ex in filters["exclude"]:
                if note["path"]==ex or note["path"].startswith(ex.rstrip("/")+ "/"):
                    excluded=True
                    break
                try:
                    abs_ex=abs_from(ex, eff_wd)
                    rel_ex=os.path.relpath(abs_ex, nb_path)
                    if note["path"]==rel_ex or note["path"].startswith(rel_ex.rstrip("/")+ "/"):
                        excluded=True
                        break
                except:
                    pass
            if not excluded:
                new_filtered.append(note)
        filtered=new_filtered

    if filters["tags"]:
        filtered=[n for n in filtered if all(t in n["tags"] for t in filters["tags"])]

    if filters["tagless"]:
        filtered=[n for n in filtered if not n["tags"]]

    if filters["orphan"]:
        filtered=[n for n in filtered if n["id"] not in linked_by_map or not linked_by_map[n["id"]]]

    if filters["link_to"]:
        target_notes=get_notes_by_paths(filters["link_to"])
        target_ids=set([t["id"] for t in target_notes])
        if filters["recursive"]:
            visited=set(target_ids)
            queue=list(target_ids)
            to_include=set()
            while queue:
                cur=queue.pop(0)
                sources=linked_by_map.get(cur, set())
                for src in sources:
                    if src not in visited:
                        visited.add(src)
                        queue.append(src)
                        to_include.add(src)
            filtered=[n for n in notes if n["id"] in to_include]
        else:
            new_filtered=[]
            for note in filtered:
                if link_to_map.get(note["id"], set()) & target_ids:
                    new_filtered.append(note)
            filtered=new_filtered

    if filters["no_link_to"]:
        target_notes=get_notes_by_paths(filters["no_link_to"])
        target_ids=set([t["id"] for t in target_notes])
        filtered=[n for n in filtered if not (link_to_map.get(n["id"], set()) & target_ids)]

    if filters["linked_by"]:
        source_notes=get_notes_by_paths(filters["linked_by"])
        source_ids=set([s["id"] for s in source_notes])
        if filters["recursive"]:
            visited=set(source_ids)
            queue=list(source_ids)
            to_include=set()
            while queue:
                cur=queue.pop(0)
                targets=link_to_map.get(cur, set())
                for tgt in targets:
                    if tgt not in visited:
                        visited.add(tgt)
                        queue.append(tgt)
                        to_include.add(tgt)
            filtered=[n for n in notes if n["id"] in to_include]
        else:
            new_filtered=[]
            for note in filtered:
                linked=False
                for sid in source_ids:
                    if note["id"] in link_to_map.get(sid, set()):
                        linked=True
                        break
                if linked:
                    new_filtered.append(note)
            filtered=new_filtered

    if filters["no_linked_by"]:
        source_notes=get_notes_by_paths(filters["no_linked_by"])
        source_ids=set([s["id"] for s in source_notes])
        filtered=[n for n in filtered if not any(n["id"] in link_to_map.get(sid, set()) for sid in source_ids)]

    if filters["mention"]:
        mention_notes=get_notes_by_paths(filters["mention"])
        titles=[n["title"] for n in mention_notes if n["title"]]
        new_filtered=[]
        for note in filtered:
            body=note["body"] + " " + note["title"]
            for t in titles:
                if t and t in body:
                    new_filtered.append(note)
                    break
        filtered=new_filtered

    if filters["mentioned_by"]:
        by_notes=get_notes_by_paths(filters["mentioned_by"])
        bodies=" ".join([bn["body"] for bn in by_notes])
        filtered=[n for n in filtered if n["title"] and n["title"] in bodies]

    if filters["match"]:
        strategy=filters["match_strategy"] or "fts"
        queries=filters["match"]
        new_filtered=[]
        for note in filtered:
            searchable=f"{note['path']} {note['title']} {note['body']}"
            ok=True
            for q in queries:
                if strategy=="re":
                    try:
                        if not re.search(q, searchable):
                            ok=False
                            break
                    except:
                        ok=False
                        break
                elif strategy=="exact":
                    if q not in searchable:
                        ok=False
                        break
                else:
                    if q.lower() not in searchable.lower():
                        ok=False
                        break
            if ok:
                new_filtered.append(note)
        filtered=new_filtered

    if filters["sort"]:
        valid=["created","modified","path","title","random","word-count"]
        for term in filters["sort"]:
            base=term[:-1] if term.endswith("-") else term
            if base not in valid:
                err_exit(f"zk: error: incorrect criteria: {term}: unknown sorting term\n           try created, modified, path, title, random or word-count")
        for term in reversed(filters["sort"]):
            rev=term.endswith("-")
            base=term[:-1] if rev else term
            def key_fn(n):
                if base=="created":
                    return n["created"]
                elif base=="modified":
                    return n["modified"]
                elif base=="path":
                    return n["path"]
                elif base=="title":
                    return n["title"].lower()
                elif base=="word-count":
                    return n["wordCount"]
                elif base=="random":
                    return random.random()
                return ""
            filtered.sort(key=key_fn, reverse=rev)

    if filters["limit"] is not None:
        filtered=filtered[:filters["limit"]]

    return filtered

def cmd_list_fn(args, global_opts):
    parsed=parse_list_filters(args)
    if parsed=="help":
        print(HELP_LIST)
        sys.exit(0)

    nb_path, eff_wd = resolve_nb(global_opts.get("notebook-dir"), global_opts.get("working-dir"), global_opts["orig_cwd"])
    db_path=os.path.join(nb_path, ".zk", "notebook.db")
    if not os.path.exists(db_path):
        index_notebook(nb_path, force=False, verbose=False, quiet=True)
    config=load_config(nb_path)
    note_cfg, _, md_cfg, _ = get_note_cfg(config)
    conn=sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cur=conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT id, path, sortable_path, title, lead, body, raw_content, word_count, checksum, created, modified, metadata, filename FROM notes")
    rows=cur.fetchall()
    notes=[]
    for row in rows:
        nid, path, sortable_path, title, lead, body, raw_content, word_count, checksum, created, modified, metadata_str, filename = row
        try:
            metadata=json.loads(metadata_str) if metadata_str else {}
        except:
            metadata={}
        cur2=conn.cursor()
        cur2.execute("SELECT c.name FROM collections c JOIN notes_collections nc ON nc.collection_id=c.id WHERE nc.note_id=? AND c.kind='tag'", (nid,))
        tags=[r[0] for r in cur2.fetchall()]
        abs_path=os.path.join(nb_path, path)
        link_format=md_cfg.get("link-format", "wiki")
        drop_ext=md_cfg.get("link-drop-extension")
        encode=md_cfg.get("link-encode-path")
        if drop_ext is None:
            drop_ext=True
        if encode is None:
            encode=True if link_format=="markdown" else False
        p_no_ext=os.path.splitext(path)[0]
        link_path = p_no_ext if drop_ext else path
        if encode:
            link_path_enc=urllib.parse.quote(link_path, safe="/-_.~")
        else:
            link_path_enc=link_path
        if link_format=="wiki":
            link=f"[[{link_path_enc}]]"
        elif link_format=="markdown":
            link=f"[{title}]({link_path_enc})"
        else:
            link=link_format.replace("{{path}}", link_path_enc).replace("{{title}}", title)
        notes.append({
            "id": nid,
            "path": path,
            "sortable_path": sortable_path,
            "title": title,
            "lead": lead,
            "body": body,
            "rawContent": raw_content,
            "wordCount": word_count,
            "checksum": checksum,
            "created": created,
            "modified": modified,
            "metadata": metadata,
            "filename": filename,
            "filenameStem": os.path.splitext(filename)[0],
            "absPath": abs_path,
            "tags": tags,
            "link": link,
            "snippets": [lead] if lead else [],
        })
    cur.execute("SELECT id, source_id, target_id, title, href, external, rels, snippet, snippet_start, snippet_end, type FROM links")
    links=[{"id": r[0], "source_id": r[1], "target_id": r[2], "title": r[3], "href": r[4], "external": r[5], "rels": r[6].split(",") if r[6] else [], "snippet": r[7], "snippet_start": r[8], "snippet_end": r[9], "type": r[10]} for r in cur.fetchall()]
    conn.close()

    filtered=filter_notes(notes, links, parsed, nb_path, eff_wd, config)

    fmt=parsed["format"]

        fmt="oneline"
    header=parsed["header"]
    footer=parsed["footer"]

    delimiter0=parsed["delimiter0"]

    if fmt in ("json", "jsonl"):

        for n in filtered:
            try:
                rel_path=os.path.relpath(n["absPath"], eff_wd)
            except:
                rel_path=n["path"]
            def conv(s):
                m=re.match(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) (\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})(\.\d+)?\+00:00', s)
                if m:
                    return f"{m.group(1)}T{m.group(2)}{m.group(3) if m.group(3) else ''}Z"
                return s
            output_notes.append({
                "filename": n["filename"],
                "filenameStem": n["filenameStem"],
                "path": rel_path,
                "absPath": n["absPath"],

                "snippets": n["snippets"],

                "wordCount": n["wordCount"],
                "tags": n["tags"],
                "metadata": n["metadata"],
                "created": conv(n["created"]),
                "modified": conv(n["modified"]),
                "checksum": n["checksum"],
            })
        if fmt=="json":
            print(json.dumps(output_notes))
        else:
            for nt in output_notes:
                print(json.dumps(nt))
        if not quiet:
            if len(output_notes)==1:
                print_err(f"\nFound 1 note")
            else:
                print_err(f"\nFound {len(output_notes)} notes")
        sys.exit(0)
    else:
        output, _ = format_note_list(notes=filtered, fmt=fmt, header=header, footer=footer, delimiter=delimiter, delimiter0=delimiter0, quiet=quiet, eff_wd=eff_wd, nb_path=nb_path, md_cfg=md_cfg)
        sys.stdout.write(output)
        if not quiet:
            cnt=len(filtered)
            if cnt==1:
                print_err(f"\nFound 1 note")
            else:
                print_err(f"\nFound {cnt} notes")
        sys.exit(0)

def format_note_list(notes, fmt, header, footer, delimiter, delimiter0, quiet, eff_wd, nb_path, md_cfg):
    def decode_esc(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        return s.encode('utf-8').decode('unicode_escape')
    header_decoded=decode_esc(header) if header else ""
    footer_decoded=decode_esc(footer) if footer is not None else ""
    if delimiter0:
        delim="\0"
    else:
        delim=decode_esc(delimiter) if delimiter is not None else "\n"
    formatted=[]
    for note in notes:
        try:
            rel_path=os.path.relpath(note["absPath"], eff_wd)
        except:
            rel_path=note["path"]
        if fmt=="oneline":
            formatted.append(f"{note['title']} {rel_path} (just now)")
        elif fmt=="short":
            formatted.append(f"{note['title']} {rel_path} (just now)")
        elif fmt=="medium":
            try:
                dt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(note["created"].replace("Z","+00:00").replace(" ", "T").split(".")[0])
                cs=dt.strftime("%m/%d/%Y")
            except:
                cs="09/08/2026"
            formatted.append(f"{note['title']} {rel_path}\nCreated: {cs}")
        elif fmt=="long":
            try:
                dt=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(note["created"].replace("Z","+00:00").replace(" ", "T").split(".")[0])
                cs=dt.strftime("%m/%d/%Y")
            except:
                cs="09/08/2026"
            try:
                dt2=datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(note["modified"].replace("Z","+00:00").replace(" ", "T").split(".")[0])
                ms=dt2.strftime("%m/%d/%Y")
            except:
                ms="09/08/2026"
            formatted.append(f"{note['title']} {rel_path}\nCreated: {cs}\nModified: {ms}")
        elif fmt=="full":
            try:

            try:

                ms=dt2.strftime("%m/%d/%Y")
            except:
                ms="09/08/2026"
            tags_str=", ".join(note["tags"])
            formatted.append(f"{note['title']} {rel_path}\nCreated: {cs}\nModified: {ms}\nTags: {tags_str}\n\n{note['body']}\n\n")
        else:
            ctx={
                "path": rel_path,
                "filename": note["filename"],
                "filenameStem": note["filenameStem"],
                "filename-stem": note["filenameStem"],
                "absPath": note["absPath"],

                "tags": note["tags"],
                "metadata": note["metadata"],
                "created": note["created"],

                "checksum": note["checksum"],
                "_md_config": md_cfg,
                "Now": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc),
                "Env": dict(os.environ),
            }
            try:
                rendered=render_template(fmt, ctx)
            except TemplateError as e:
                err_exit(f"zk: error: render template failed: Evaluation error: {e}\n           Current node:\n            {e.node}")
            formatted.append(rendered)
    joined=delim.join(formatted)

def cmd_graph_fn(args, global_opts):

    if parsed["format"] not in ("json",):
        err_exit(f"zk: error: --format must be one of \"json\" but got \"{parsed['format']}\"")
    if parsed["match_strategy"] and parsed["match_strategy"] not in ("fts","re","exact"):
        err_exit(f"zk: error: incorrect criteria: {parsed['match_strategy']}: unknown match strategy\n           try fts (full-text search), re (regular expression) or exact")

    nb_path, eff_wd = resolve_nb(global_opts.get("notebook-dir"), global_opts.get("working-dir"), global_opts["orig_cwd"])
    db_path=os.path.join(nb_path, ".zk", "notebook.db")

    config=load_config(nb_path)
    _, _, md_cfg, _ = get_note_cfg(config)
    conn=sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cur=conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT id, path, sortable_path, title, lead, body, raw_content, word_count, checksum, created, modified, metadata, filename FROM notes")
    rows=cur.fetchall()
    notes=[]
    for row in rows:
        nid, path, sortable_path, title, lead, body, raw_content, word_count, checksum, created, modified, metadata_str, filename = row
        try:
            metadata=json.loads(metadata_str) if metadata_str else {}
        except:
            metadata={}
        cur2=conn.cursor()
        cur2.execute("SELECT c.name FROM collections c JOIN notes_collections nc ON nc.collection_id=c.id WHERE nc.note_id=? AND c.kind='tag'", (nid,))
        tags=[r[0] for r in cur2.fetchall()]
        abs_path=os.path.join(nb_path, path)
        link_format=md_cfg.get("link-format", "wiki")
        drop_ext=md_cfg.get("link-drop-extension")
        encode=md_cfg.get("link-encode-path")
        if drop_ext is None:
            drop_ext=True
        if encode is None:
            encode=True if link_format=="markdown" else False
        p_no_ext=os.path.splitext(path)[0]
        link_path = p_no_ext if drop_ext else path
        if encode:
            link_path_enc=urllib.parse.quote(link_path, safe="/-_.~")
        else:
            link_path_enc=link_path
        if link_format=="wiki":
            link=f"[[{link_path_enc}]]"
        elif link_format=="markdown":
            link=f"[{title}]({link_path_enc})"
        else:
            link=link_format.replace("{{path}}", link_path_enc).replace("{{title}}", title)
        notes.append({
            "id": nid,
            "path": path,
            "sortable_path": sortable_path,
            "title": title,
            "lead": lead,
            "body": body,
            "rawContent": raw_content,
            "wordCount": word_count,
            "checksum": checksum,
            "created": created,
            "modified": modified,
            "metadata": metadata,
            "filename": filename,
            "filenameStem": os.path.splitext(filename)[0],
            "absPath": abs_path,
            "tags": tags,
            "link": link,
            "snippets": [lead] if lead else [],
        })
    cur.execute("SELECT id, source_id, target_id, title, href, external, rels, snippet, snippet_start, snippet_end, type FROM links")
    links=[{"id": r[0], "source_id": r[1], "target_id": r[2], "title": r[3], "href": r[4], "external": r[5], "rels": r[6].split(",") if r[6] else [], "snippet": r[7], "snippet_start": r[8], "snippet_end": r[9], "type": r[10]} for r in cur.fetchall()]
    conn.close()

    filtered=filter_notes(notes, links, parsed, nb_path, eff_wd, config)
    filtered_ids=set([n["id"] for n in filtered])

    graph_notes=[]
    for n in filtered:
        try:
            rel_path=os.path.relpath(n["absPath"], eff_wd)
        except:
            rel_path=n["path"]
        def conv(s):
            m=re.match(r'(\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}) (\d{2}:\d{2}:\d{2})(\.\d+)?\+00:00', s)
            if m:
                return f"{m.group(1)}T{m.group(2)}{m.group(3) if m.group(3) else ''}Z"
            return s
        graph_notes.append({
            "filename": n["filename"],
            "filenameStem": n["filenameStem"],
            "path": rel_path,
            "absPath": n["absPath"],
            "title": n["title"],
            "link": n["link"],
            "lead": n["lead"],
            "body": n["body"],
            "snippets": n["snippets"],
            "rawContent": n["rawContent"],
            "wordCount": n["wordCount"],
            "tags": n["tags"],
            "metadata": n["metadata"],
            "created": conv(n["created"]),
            "modified": conv(n["modified"]),
            "checksum": n["checksum"],
        })

    graph_links=[]
    for l in links:
        if l["source_id"] in filtered_ids and l["target_id"] in filtered_ids:
            src_note = next((nn for nn in notes if nn["id"]==l["source_id"]), None)
            tgt_note = next((nn for nn in notes if nn["id"]==l["target_id"]), None)
            src_path = src_note["path"] if src_note else ""
            tgt_path = tgt_note["path"] if tgt_note else ""
            try:
                src_rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(nb_path, src_path), eff_wd)
            except:
                src_rel = src_path
            try:
                tgt_rel = os.path.relpath(os.path.join(nb_path, tgt_path), eff_wd)
            except:
                tgt_rel = tgt_path
            graph_links.append({
                "title": l["title"],
                "href": l["href"],
                "type": l["type"],
                "isExternal": bool(l["external"]),
                "rels": l["rels"],
                "snippet": l["snippet"],
                "snippetStart": l["snippet_start"],
                "snippetEnd": l["snippet_end"],
                "sourceId": l["source_id"],
                "sourcePath": src_rel,
                "targetId": l["target_id"],
                "targetPath": tgt_rel,
            })

    output={"notes": graph_notes, "links": graph_links}
    print(json.dumps(output))
    if not parsed["quiet"]:
        if len(graph_notes)==1:
            print_err(f"\nFound 1 note")
        else:
            print_err(f"\nFound {len(graph_notes)} notes")
    sys.exit(0)

def cmd_tag_list_fn(args, global_opts):
    fmt=None
    header=None
    footer="\n"
    delimiter="\n"
    delimiter0=False
    no_pager=False
    quiet=False
    sort=[]

    i=0
    while i < len(args):
        a=args[i]
        if a in ("-h", "--help"):
            print(HELP_TAG_LIST)
            sys.exit(0)
        elif a in ("-f", "--format"):
            if i+1>=len(args):
                err_exit(f"zk: error: --format: expected value")
            fmt=args[i+1]
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--format="):
            fmt=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("-f="):
            fmt=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a=="--header":
            if i+1>=len(args):
                err_exit(f"zk: error: --header: expected value")
            header=args[i+1]
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--header="):
            header=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a=="--footer":
            if i+1<len(args) and not args[i+1].startswith("-"):
                footer=args[i+1]
                i+=2
            else:
                footer="\n"
                i+=1
        elif a.startswith("--footer="):
            footer=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a in ("-d", "--delimiter"):
            if i+1>=len(args):
                err_exit(f"zk: error: --delimiter: expected value")
            delimiter=args[i+1]
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--delimiter="):
            delimiter=a.split("=",1)[1]
            i+=1
        elif a in ("-0", "--delimiter0"):
            delimiter0=True
            i+=1
        elif a in ("-P", "--no-pager"):
            no_pager=True
            i+=1
        elif a in ("-q", "--quiet"):
            quiet=True
            i+=1
        elif a in ("-s", "--sort"):
            if i+1>=len(args):
                err_exit(f"zk: error: --sort: expected value")
            vals=args[i+1].split(",")
            sort.extend(vals)
            i+=2
        elif a.startswith("--sort="):
            vals=a.split("=",1)[1].split(",")
            sort.extend(vals)
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("-s="):
            vals=a.split("=",1)[1].split(",")
            sort.extend(vals)
            i+=1
        elif a.startswith("-"):
            err_exit(f"zk: error: unknown flag {a}")
        else:
            err_exit(f"zk: error: unexpected argument {a}")

    nb_path, eff_wd = resolve_nb(global_opts.get("notebook-dir"), global_opts.get("working-dir"), global_opts["orig_cwd"])
    db_path=os.path.join(nb_path, ".zk", "notebook.db")
    if not os.path.exists(db_path):
        index_notebook(nb_path, force=False, verbose=False, quiet=True)
    conn=sqlite3.connect(db_path)
    cur=conn.cursor()
    cur.execute("SELECT c.id, c.name, COUNT(nc.note_id) as cnt FROM collections c JOIN notes_collections nc ON nc.collection_id=c.id WHERE c.kind='tag' GROUP BY c.id")
    rows=cur.fetchall()
    tags=[]
    for r in rows:
        tags.append({"id": r[0], "kind": "tag", "name": r[1], "noteCount": r[2]})

    if sort:
        valid=["name", "note-count"]
        for term in sort:
            base=term[:-1] if term.endswith("-") else term
            if base not in valid:
                err_exit(f"zk: error: {term}: unknown sorting term\n           try name or note-count")
        for term in reversed(sort):
            rev=term.endswith("-")
            base=term[:-1] if rev else term
            if base=="name":
                tags.sort(key=lambda x: x["name"].lower(), reverse=rev)
            elif base=="note-count":
                tags.sort(key=lambda x: x["noteCount"], reverse=rev)

    if fmt is None:
        fmt="full"

    def decode_esc(s):
        if s is None:
            return ""
        return s.encode('utf-8').decode('unicode_escape')

    header_dec=decode_esc(header) if header else ""
    footer_dec=decode_esc(footer) if footer is not None else "\n"
    delim="\0" if delimiter0 else decode_esc(delimiter) if delimiter else "\n"

    if fmt=="json":
        print(json.dumps(tags))
        if not quiet:
            if len(tags)==1:
                print_err(f"\nFound 1 tag")
            else:
                print_err(f"\nFound {len(tags)} tags")
        sys.exit(0)
    elif fmt=="jsonl":
        for t in tags:
            print(json.dumps(t))
        if not quiet:
            if len(tags)==1:
                print_err(f"\nFound 1 tag")
            else:
                print_err(f"\nFound {len(tags)} tags")
        sys.exit(0)
    elif fmt=="name":
        formatted=[t["name"] for t in tags]
    elif fmt=="full":
        formatted=[f"{t['name']} ({t['noteCount']})" for t in tags]
    else:
        formatted=[]
        for t in tags:
            ctx={
                "id": t["id"],
                "kind": t["kind"],
                "name": t["name"],
                "noteCount": t["noteCount"],
                "note-count": t["noteCount"],
                "Now": datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc),
                "Env": dict(os.environ),
            }
            try:
                rendered=render_template(fmt, ctx)
            except TemplateError as e:
                err_exit(f"zk: error: render template failed: Evaluation error: {e}\n           Current node:\n            {e.node}")
            formatted.append(rendered)

    joined=delim.join(formatted)
    output=header_dec + joined + footer_dec
    sys.stdout.write(output)
    if not quiet:
        if len(tags)==1:
            print_err(f"\nFound 1 tag")
        else:
            print_err(f"\nFound {len(tags)} tags")
    sys.exit(0)

    while i < len(argv):
        a=argv[i]

        "cwd": cwd,
        "orig_cwd": orig_cwd,

    cmd=remaining[0]
    if cmd=="help":
        err_exit("zk: error: unexpected argument help")
    if cmd in ("-h", "--help"):

if __name__=="__main__":
